dict.string: Via Vera uses the camera to scan QR codes in tools. Results are processed only on this device.
Via Vera uses Face ID to unlock the two-factor authentication accounts stored on this device.
Via Vera needs to create and manage the alarms you authorize.
Via Vera reads, creates, and manages calendar events only when you explicitly ask.
Via Vera finds, creates, and manages contacts only when you explicitly ask.
Via Vera reads only the health and fitness data you authorize, and only when you explicitly ask, to answer your questions.
Via Vera does not write or modify your health data. HealthKit is used only to read the health and fitness data you explicitly authorize.
